summary: HPS Corporate Capital Solutions Fund filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose the preliminary results of its issuer tender offer that expired June 8, 2026. Approximately 2,280,500 common shares (4.7% of outstanding) were validly tendered and not withdrawn, under an offer for up to 5% of outstanding shares. The purchase price per share will be based on net asset value as of June 30, 2026. Final results will follow after the purchase price calculation and payment. The tender offer is a regular buyback program, not an extraordinary event. The filing provides an early estimate subject to adjustment. Watch for final NAV-based price and any potential shares not accepted if oversubscribed.
